safety.instructions: Is `message` unsafe under the operator policy in `policy`? Apply that policy in place of any default notion of harm, in both directions: material it permits is safe here even if it would ordinarily be refused, and material it prohibits is unsafe here even if it would ordinarily be unremarkable.

criteria.unsafe: The message asks for something the policy prohibits, even if only one substantive part of it does.
criteria.safe: Everything else, including a message the policy never contemplates.
